balls.text: short ball, 130ks, not quite the slower one, Wiese gets under it, and cuts it over short third. Just clears the boundary, and it is an even 200
yorker on leg, looks to squeeze it to the point boundary but can't beat the tight field square on the off side
slower bouncer. Rinky aborts the pull and tries to ramp it, but is beaten. Too late to change the shot
guesses right, goers for the ramp, gets a fullie, misses it, but Rinku steals the leg-bye
silences the R-C-B chants. What a downswing. Delays it to adjust to the slower ball, and what sweet timing. Well over wide long-on for the biggest six of the innings
slower ball full toss, dipping on him, no timing on the shot, gets a single to long leg
lovely yorker speared into the leg stump. Russell is bowled as he clears the front leg to hit. Superb comeback from Siraj after going for 14 in the first three balls
looks to slog it, but it is a touch too short for it. The mis-hit lands between deep midwicket and long-on. Gets a single
finally a dot for Siraj through a sharp bouncer. Rinku doesn't even go after it
full, wide and fast, and this time Rinku gets more bat on it. The last one you could say was a little lucky but this one he has nailed it. Drives it over point, between deep third and deep cover
slower wide ball, but there is no deep third. Gets it wide of short third with a slice
Rinku is in some hitting form. A length ball at 144ks, on off, and he goes against the angle and slogs him over deep midwicket
roundarm legbreak, pushed into the leg side for one
on a length, slider, punched straight to short cover

and when Iyer tries the slog sweep, it turns out to be the wrong'un. Bowled two legbreaks when they were playing for the wrong'un, and now slips in the wrong'un. Goes a mile in the air, and Maxwell takes it at long-on. Once again turning the momentum around is Hasaranga
slow legbreak, pushed into the covers for a single

finally they catch Rana. It is Vyshak who does it. Another reverse sweep but Hasaranga is bowling legbreaks and not wrong'uns. The top edge goes towards short third who dives forward to take the catch
oh he starts with a legbreak, which turns appreciable and beats his reverse sweep to concede just the leg-bye
wow, a parallel six. Rana is playing a blinder. Shuffles across, gets a half-volley and drills it flat over the diving deep extra cover. A late flick of the wrists there to get power into it
back to slower ball, but a touch too full, and Rana throws his bat at it. Gets an outside edge that beats short third to his right
tries the bluff ball. A 138ks yorker with no protection square of the wicket. Rana opens the face and gets four through square third
this is on pace, 133ks, short and wide, and it is played straight to deep cover. Iyer is not happy
wide length ball, driven hard but along the ground to long-off
slower ball, mis-hit to long-on for one
that's a lovely flick. Harshal bowls short of a length, he takes a step towards the ball and then flicks it off the hip for another six in the same region
Rana is waiting for the slower ball this time. Gets inside the line of the short ball, and pulls it way above long leg. He was expecting a slower short ball
slower one again, on a length, opens the face for a single
the pitch is out of equation on this ball. Slower ball, full bunger, and he drills it back over his head for four
and Rana just can't get out today. Hit flat and straight to long-on, but it bounces just in front. These are signs of a slower-than-usual pitch
slower yorker on the toes, and they sneak in a leg-bye with the ball on the pitch
upper-cut but no timing. Just the single as deep cover has time to come around

another drop, this time Harshal Patel at fine leg. Rana tries his trademark pull after getting inside the line, but Siraj has fine leg in place. Again, just like the Siraj drop, it hits the thigh and not the hands
mis-hits a length ball, but it falls short of long-on
another superb wide yorker at 143ks. Beats Iyer. Valuable dot
yorker outside off, and they have a deep third for the steer. Good field placement, good bowling
short of a length, outside off, punched to deep cover
backs away, then shimmies down the wicket, and drills this down the ground, but the long-off is pretty straight. Keeps them down to one
slower ball, into the pads, and gets a single on the heavily patrolled leg-side boundary
backs away even as Willey is running in. Willey stays on a length and straight, and Iyer is back where he started, and drives it down to long-on for one
slower offcutter, cramps him up as he looks to make room. They sneak in a single off the bottom edge
lovely shot. Showed him the ramp early, Willey tried to go behind him, but he got enough bat and a late flick of the wrist to clear short fine leg
on a length, angling in, punched down to long-on for one
this time Rana had set himself up for the slower ball. Right in his slot, and the down swing of the bat is timed perfectly. Goes back overt his head for a six
quicker ball, 135ks, beats his lofted off-drive on the outside edge
wide length ball, driven with an open face, backward point dives and keeps them to one
dropped at long-off. A nice slower one again, Rana lofts it down the ground, straight down Siraj's lap, but it bursts through his hands and bounces off his thigh
on-pace short ball, 131ks, too high, and called a wide
slower ball, short of a length, cut to deep cover for another single
short, pulled away to deep midwicket. He has been bowling to his field all night
a touch short, wide, cut square of the sweeper on the off side. Gets two
picks the wrong'un, and drives the half-volley straight of short extra cover and wide of long-off. Lovely shot
wrong'un, sweep-pull from wide outside off, gets a single to deep midwicket
legbreak, on a length, punched down to long-off for one
a touch short, and Iyer hits his first boundary. Places the pull between deep square and deep midwicket. First boundary in 17 balls
on a length, legbreak, worked into the leg side for one
slower-ball yorker, on off, draws a dot
short of a length, outside off, cut hard but again straight to the sweeper
slower ball, outside off, driven to deep cover for another single
dipping slower ball, yorker, on middle and off, worked square on the leg side. back of the hand it is
square-drive on the up, but can't beat the deep square third
short of a length, no room, punched to short cover
wide down the leg side. So the plan seems to be to tuck Iyer up

what a time to go for the change-up. Vyshak has frustrated Roy with the wide lines for two overs now. This time Roy shuffles across, and Vyshak has nailed a leg-stump yorker. I wonder if Vyshak saw the foot moving, and then changed up at the last moment. The foot did move before the release. And if he did that after seeing the foot move, this is a great spell of limited-overs bowling against a destructive batter
wide length ball, on pace, pushed to deep cover for another single
slower ball, short of a length, but wide down the leg side
slower ball and again he is hiding it wide and away from Roy. Just the single to deep point
down the wicket to drive this length ball to deep cover for one
bouncer first up. Too high. Called wide
caught at deep midwicket. Vyshak bowls the bouncer, gets good height on it, Jagadeesan pulls, doesn't get all of it, and finds the deep midwicket
short and wide, but he is bowling to his field. Cut away to deep cover again
another slower short ball that just doesn't arrive. Jagadeesan gets a bottom edge through to Karthik
slower short ball, pulled down to deep midwicket for one
slower ball again, nearly a yorker, dug out to deep cover for one
finally he gets going. Harshal tries the change-up by going on pace, and offers a short, wide delivery. Cut above point for four
Jagadeesan backs away and is beaten by a wide slower ball from Harshal. This is from the back of the hand
again a grunt from Roy as he has cut a wide slower ball straight to deep cover
slower ball, but a wide half-volley, and Roy is not happy that he has hit it straight to long-off
tries to hook, gets a top edge, and gets a single to fine leg. Falls just short
slower short ball, the bottom hand co0mes off as he is early into the pull. Gets a single to deep square leg
that's a pull but with no power. Just about clears midwicket
cut away hard but he is trying to keep it down. Gets two to deep point
will be harsh to call this a drop. He has hit this hard to his left. Does well to get a hand to it. Brings up his fifty off just 22
another dot from Jagadeesan, this time a legbreak. Defended right back to him
Roy pulls out the reverse-sweep, but short third dives to his left to save three
slightly short , and cut away to deep point for one
another wrong'un and another dot. Jagadeesan has to value his wicket less
another wrong'un, another dot. He is picking it off the surface
wrong'un, ends up around leg, no room, played back to him
this time he stands still, takes it from leg stump, and slog-sweeps it away into the stands over midwicket. What an over for Roy and KKR
backing away again, Shahbaz follows him again and beats him on the sweep
he is backing away to go off side, but pulls because Shahbaz has fired it into him. He hasn't got all of it, and it is going straight to deep midwicket but hello, it sails over him
this time he uses the power. Slog sweep after clearing the front leg. Goes at catching height but square of deep midwicket
lovely chip shot for a six. Wow what timing. Down the wicket, Shahbaz looks to follow his toes and cramp him, but he just chips it with no follow-through. Over mid-on it goes
short of a length, he goes back in the crease, and slaps it wide of mid-on for one
okay he has tried two regulation sweeps and has been beaten so he tries the reverse and nails it. Between point and cover. All along the ground
really full, nearly a half-volley, and he misses out on the big slog. Missing leg here

beaten on the sweep by a wrong'un, big appeal for lbw, not given, and reviewed. Has Roy got himself outside the line? My first impression is, he has. And replays confirm that he is hit outside the line of the stumps. RCB lose the review
wrong'un, cramping him up, defended back to him
too full, nearly a yorker, dug out to mid-off for a quick single
into the pads, and pushed to deep midwicket for one
this is on a good length, pushed down to long-on for one
that's a freebie. Inswinging half-volley on his pads, and he has just clipped it off the toes for a flat six over square midwicket
mid-off is right on the edge of the circle, and he pushes it to the man and charges off for one
looks to steer this square but can't beat the man at backward point
this time he shimmies a little, takes this length ball on the half-volley, and drives it along the ground and wide of mid-off. A really quick outfield here
gets some swing but starts from outside leg, and is called a wide
finally Jagadeesan gets going. And it is a lovely cover-drive. On a length, no swing, and he crashes it through the covers. No pre-ball movement from the batter this time
sharp bouncer, Roy beaten on the hook, and Karthik appeals for the catch. Not given, and no review either
gorgeous cover-drive. One that justifies the gate money. Wide outswinger from Siraj, and he plants the front foot down, breaks his back knee, and drives it to the left of cover
wobble seam, this one nips back in, and he runs it down to deep third for one
beaten again as this shortish ball moves away from him
more pre-ball movement, but Jagadeesan is yet to find the boundary with an in-control shot
lovely outswinger, Jagadeesan caught on the crease, and is beaten on the outside edge
runs this down to deep square third for a single
again walks at him, drives this one but straight to short cover
walks at him again, Willey stays on a length and starts outside leg. Pushed to short straight midwicket
slight shimmy down again. This one swings. Defended to leg
no swing. Jagadeesan slashes at it as it is angled across. The edge goes wide of slip and straight of deep third who is quite square
Jagadeesan walks at him, defends a length ball
half an appeal as this one nips back in but Siraj is quick to realise this is headed down leg. Either it has done too much or taken the inside edge. This is the wobble seam ball
and Roy finds the gap between the bowler and that short straight mid-off who is maybe two metres off the pitch. And the mid-off is wide. So he gets four
outswinger, slightly short of a length, punched to mid-on, starts running but says no as he has hit this too well
and Roy shows his first intent. Down the wicket early, Siraj slips in a wide outswinger, so Roy aborts the show over cover but goes down the ground between the bowler and mid-on
a touch of room, pushed on the up, but can't split point and cover-point
outswinger to start off with. Roy defends off the front foot
down the wicket, mis-hits into the gap between long-on and deep midwicket. They come back for the second
again looks for the reverse ramp, gets an edge onto his foot, takes a single
wide full toss, hit just wide of deep cover, and they come back for the second
full ball, slogged into the gap between deep midwicket and long-on for four. These are important runs even though they have lost the match
slower bouncer, too high, and to add to it, Jagadeesan fluffs the take
looks for the reverse ramp but ends up scooping it to square leg for one
slogs at a length ball, gets an inside edge into his leg for a single
has he plonked his bat in? Takes mid-off on because he is on the edge of the ring, and he has slid his bat in, which beats the direct hit
Vyshak hits a six. Just swings hard and across the line, gets a top edge, it goes miles in the air, and just clears deep  midwicket
wants to ramp it, beaten by a length ball
full and straight, hit hard to long-on
wants the reverse ramp but is hit on the toe by a full toss
full toss, quick, down leg, pushed to deep midwicket
full offbreak, driven to wide long-on for one
on a length, offbreak, inside edge to short fine for one
full, middle and leg, pushed to long-on for one
that is signed, sealed and delivered. Karthik has pulled a long hop straight to deep midwicket. Slow off the pitch, gets no timing on it, and it is all over for RCB
offbreak, outside off, runs off the outside edge to short third for one
slow in the air, on a length, outside off, and Willey doesn't get bat on it
slower short ball, and Anukul Roy is everywhere. This time he tidies up to his left at deep midwicket and denies them the second
wow it is KKR's day, it would appear. A slower ball, wide half-volley, Hasaranga goes down on a knee and lofts it with an open face, but he has found Anukul Roy at deep point to perfection
no he tries the yorker. It is a pretty good one, and Karthik steers it out straight to short third. A little bit either side, and it could be four
Russell has gone too cute. Slower ball, but right in the slot and also going down leg. Karthik picks it, and sweeps it for six over square leg
the stumps save at least two. Russell misses the yorker by some six inches, and Karthik drills is back the ground but into the middle stump of the non-striker's end wicket
oh he goes full. Good length, outside off, and Karthik ends up swinging inside its line. Beaten on the outside edge
nicely pushed wide of long-off for two
this one is smashed down the ground, and it seems to have taken Karthik's pad on the way. It means it goes slowly to long-on, and they take two
offbreak, similar area, worked into the leg side for one
carrom ball, slow, on off, defended
offbreak, cramps him, single to short third
a touch short, but pulled straight to deep midwicket for one
flighted wrong'un, pushed into the leg side for one

and just like MI, KKR have got Anukul Roy on the field. Legbreak, short, cut in front of deep cover. The two is on, but Prabhudessai sees Karthik is not charging back but ambling back so he starts to wonder. So he pauses, then sees Karthik is not stopping so he goes for the second. Too late by now because Anukul's throw is flat, fast and on target
wrong'un, takes the leading edge as Prabhudessai closes the face too early. It falls safe towards mid-off. This close to Suyash c X b Suyash
legbreak, too short and wide. Karthik pulls it to long-on for one
another wrong'un, flicked to deep square for one
wrong'un, top of off, cut to deep cover for one
carrom ball, flighted, Karthik opens the face, a thick edge gets them a single
soft hands, pushed to deep midwicket, keeper chases it to try to prevent the second, Iyer comes to collect the throw, but DK has put in the dive to beat the throw
offbreak, beats his inside edge, Karthik calls him through for a leg-bye but he is caught ball-watching. The throw from Jagadeesan is too full so Narine is not able to collect it
pitched up for a change, soft hands to bunt it into a gap on the leg side. Comes back for two
goes back to pull again, this time along the ground to long-on
not if he bowls so short and slow. Karthik loves this, rocks back, and pulls it between long-on and deep midwicket
that partly spoils what was a superb over. Short of a length, but gives him the width, and Prabhudessai punches this to extra cover for four
a touch too full, flicked wide of long-on for two
has he dropped him? I heard a sound as this short-of-a-length ball goes past the outside edge. Jagadeesan doesn't collect cleanly. No reaction from them
length ball, just outside off, pushed to extra cover
goes for the yorker, middle stump line, pushed back to him

is this the game? Digs one in short, and Kohli smacks a pull clean, only for Iyer to take a stunning catch at deep midwicket. This is travelling flat, Iyer dives to his left, the ball hits his hands high but he recovers to prevent it from wobbling out of the hands even as he rolls over
pulled away straight to deep midwicket
a touch short but he has a sweeper cover for protection
perfect length. Carrom ball, on a length, just outside off. Defended
smart bowling. Varun pushes this wide on the line. Lomror has to drag this one. Gets just the toe end, and is he caught at the fence on deep midwicket. Another twist
Lomror is taking all the pressure off Kohli. And the KKR spinners are missing their lengths now. Pulls this one clean over deep midwicket for six. Kohli is more pumped than Lomror
short of a length, punched to deep midwicket for one
looks for the sweep but this is too full, and he misses. Pitched outside leg
legbreak, sits up from middle and leg, worked to deep midwicket for one
wrong'un, but starts too wide in the umpire's estimation. They don't contest the call
another legbreak, hit hard and straight of long-on, and comes back for two to bring up his fifty
the surprise legbreak, surprises Kohli but there is width for Kohli to work with. He is flashing his blade at it anyway. Gets an edge fine of short third for four
a wrong'un again, and a touch short again, cut to deep cover for a single
wrong'un, a touch short, pulled down to long-on for one
angling down the leg side, Lomror gets low and sweeps hard over square leg for a flat six
tries the slog-sweep, but gets too close to its pitch. A single to deep midwicket
on a length, offbreak, punched down to long-off
offbreak, on a length, punched down to long-on for a single
slower in the air, on a length, worked to deep midwicket for one
quick ball but short, and Lomror picks the length quickly and goes way over deep midwicket with the pull. Kohli getting just the support he needs here
pushed through across him, and he has driven it straight to extra cover
seems like he tried something but bowled a full toss so don't know what. Driven down to long-on for one
full, on the toes, flicked to deep square
down the wicket, beaten in the air, but pushes it into the leg side for one
goes round arm, bowls too full, slog-swept between deep midwicket and long-on. Arora dives after running from deep midwicket but Rinku from long-on and has run too far to collect the ricochet
on a length, no turn, punched to deep midwicket for one
pushed towards deep midwicket, again they look for two but settle for one this time
this one comes in, and he goes back to push it into the leg side for one
offbreak, too short, punched wide of long-off for another couple
another carrom ball, hit above the bowler's head, and they steal a second again. A bit of a mis-hit is what it takes for Kohli to initiate the second
carrom ball, on a length, punched to deep midwicket for one
slow length ball, punched to deep cover for one
nearly a yorker, Kohli digs it out towards wide long-on, and they take a second off the tumble
short of a length, wicket to wicket, and Kohli manufactures two by softly pushing this towards long-on
stays short, too quick for his pull, but the top edge falls short of deep midwicket
gets away with this. Short of a length, down leg, but it goes off the thigh pad straight to short fine. Any bat here, and this might have been four
stays short of a length, Kohli opens the face, gets a single to the right of backward point
legcutter, short of a length, punched to extra cover
stays back to a length ball and defends
they have lost three in the powerplay. Maxwell is looking to go over mid-on, but the offbreak sort of cramps him, and ends up kinda slicing it straight to mid-off . Two of the big three of RCB gone
what manipulation of the field. Down on the ground, outside the line, and then flicks a sweep so that he goes square and behind square to beat deep midwicket
crunches a drive on the up, but straight to extra cover
short of a length, flicked to deep midwicket for one
flighted outside off, driven inside-out to extra cover
down to long-on again
on the shorter side, and Maxwell thumps a pull to long-on for one

that is out one of the two ways, and Shahbaz walks off. The fullest Suyash has bowled today, and Shahbaz is beaten on the sweep. He is dead plumb but just in case he has got an edge, it has lobbed up for a catch too. In the end he is out lbw. Replays show he got a bit of a feather, but it doesn't matter
on a length, glanced to short fine for a single
for a moment this looks dangerous as Kohli has pulled this in the air towards long-on. Rinku goes for the catch, gets there on the half-volley, and is beaten
as expected, he is waiting for it. And this is a touch short too. Kohli plays the flick pull in order to miss deep midwicket
on a length, middle and leg, punched to deep midwicket for one
such quick running. Pushes this legbreak with soft hands towards long-on, and steals two
signs of turn there as this one goes off the shoulder of his defensive bat for another quick single
offbreak, glanced to short fine, and they steal a single
on a length, turns a touch in, yes and no as Kohli looks to drop and run. Kohli not happy with Shahbaz
a touch too short, and Kohli is quick to pull it over square leg for four
another wrong'un, on a length, goes off the glove to short fine for a quick single
short of a length, wrong'un, pushed to mid-on for a quick single
on a length, wrong'un, punched to extra cover again
another googly, just short of a length, punched to extra cover

and Suyash has the wicket. Wow what a challenge, and he has aced it. Wrong'un, flighted, and du Plessis makes room to go over long-on, but doesn't get all of it. A smart overhead catch by Rinku at the fence
wrong'un, short, punched down to long-on for one
that's a du Plessis special. Short of a length, into the body, but he clears his front leg and lofts a pull over wide mid-on for six
one slower ball too many. Faf picks it, and also it is a half-volley on the pads. He lofts it over mid-on for six
sees him come at him and bowls the slower full wide ball. Kohli gets just the single
short of a length, nips back in, hits the inside edge for one
down the wicket, ends up yorking himself up, steers it down to deep point for one
easy as. Kohli gets the width, and extends his hands through it. Deliberately in the air and over extra cover
swinging in towards off, punched straight to extra cover
those are lucky runs. He has flicked an inswinger straight to short fine but it falls just short of short fine and then speeds off to beat Suyash Sharma. Suyash will know he should be doing better
inswinger, on a length, pushed wide of cover-point for one
inswinger, misses the edge, hits the pad, headed down leg. Kohli steals a leg-bye but Faf has to put a dive in at the non-striker's
length ball, angling in, steered to deep square third for one
a wide length ball, and Kohli can throw his hands at it. You can say it has flown off the edge over short third but this ball deserves four
